question:
How many paper are not bottles? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76fdc90a0a5e41261a0afe1551fa53578765afe98596fe344ec2f6c77dc14cd6.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7422ea79272d1f865e91079d7e6bbbd63b15208561d6d9ff16e60dd78ccfe6db.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of paper are not bottles".

So, the total number of paper are not bottles = 8 + 3 = 11.

Hence, the correct answer is "11".
